metadata.name: living-docs-governance
metadata.description: Keep a long-lived project's documentation from rotting by assigning existing project docs clear constitution, map, status, and history roles, then wiring the active agent harness to those canonical sources. Use in the maintain phase when docs drift from code, agents lose context between sessions, or intentional removals keep being recreated. Prefer adopting the repository's current docs structure over creating new root files. Trigger concepts: documentation governance, living documentation, project status tracking, drift prevention, project maps, health dashboards, deletion zones, and long-term project governance.
